summary: Crash when setting LodestonePos of compass to something other than NBT compound
description: The bug The game crashes when changing or creating a compass item with a LodestonePos having a value other than an NBT compound tag. [^(20w17a) crash-2020-04-23_21.44.55-server.txt] Description: Ticking player java.lang.ClassCastException: lp cannot be cast to la at bhr.a(SourceFile:144) at bje.a(SourceFile:454) at bcw.j(SourceFile:290) at bcx.l(SourceFile:575) at anz.h(SourceFile:2217) at bcx.h(SourceFile:274) at ys.i(SourceFile:411) at zj.b(SourceFile:199) at ma.a(SourceFile:234) at zi.c(SourceFile:171) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.b(SourceFile:839) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.a(SourceFile:766) at enn.a(SourceFile:89) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.run(SourceFile:625) at java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:745) How to reproduce Do this in a test world /give @s compass{LodestoneDimension:"minecraft:overworld",LodestonePos:"This is not an NBT compound"} The game freezes and you will see in the log file that it has crashed
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings or load an existing test world.
3. Execute the command: `/give @s compass{LodestoneDimension:"minecraft:overworld",LodestonePos:"This is not an NBT compound"}`.
4. Observe that the game freezes and crashes, as indicated by the log file.
Observed Behavior: The game crashes when attempting to change or create a compass item with a LodestonePos value that is not an NBT compound tag. This issue was identified in version 20w17a, and the crash can be reproduced by using the command `/give @s compass{LodestoneDimension:"minecraft:overworld",LodestonePos:"This is not an NBT compound"}` in a test world. When this command is executed, the game freezes, and the log file will indicate that it has crashed due to a `java.lang.ClassCastException`. The specific error message in the crash report is "lp cannot be cast to la," which points to a problem within the code where an incorrect data type is being used for LodestonePos. This bug affects both single-player and server environments, making it critical for developers to address this issue promptly.
Expected Behavior: When a compass with an invalid `LodestonePos` value (such as a string instead of an NBT compound) is created or modified, the game should not crash. Instead, the compass should either retain its previous state or default to a standard compass without any lodestone tracking. The player should be able to continue playing without interruption.
